title: Controlling the Diversity-Quality Trade-Off of LLMs by Merging Models Before and After Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.22999v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Alignment is known to change the output characteristics of large language models (LLMs). Base models tend to generate more diverse outputs, whereas aligned models tend to produce higher-quality outputs. The appropriate balance between the two depends on the task. Existing methods either require costly fine-tuning or, like temperature sampling, mainly improve lexical diversity rather than semantic diversity. We introduce a depth-aware FrankenMerging approach for controlling the diversity--quality trade-off between an aligned model and its base model without additional training. This approach combines the lower layers of an aligned model with the higher layers of its base model based on the hypothesis that lexical diversity is more closely associated with lower layers and semantic diversity with higher layers. translated_title: 通过合并对齐前后的模型来控制大语言模型的多样性-质量权衡
translated_abstract: 对齐被认为会改变大语言模型（LLM）的输出特性。基础模型往往生成更加多样的输出，而对齐模型则倾向于产生更高质量的输出。两者之间的适当平衡取决于具体任务。现有方法要么需要代价高昂的微调，要么像温度采样那样主要提升词汇多样性而非语义多样性。我们提出了一种深度感知的 FrankenMerging 方法，用于在无需额外训练的情况下控制对齐模型与其基础模型之间的多样性-质量权衡。该方法基于这样一个假设：词汇多样性与模型的较低层关系更密切，而语义多样性与较高层关系更密切，因此将一个对齐模型的较低层与基础模型的较高层相结合。实验表明，改变从每个模型中选取的层数可以同时调节多样性和质量。在大多数情况下，该方法……
tldr: 提出一种无需额外训练的深度感知 FrankenMerging 方法，通过将对齐模型的低层与基础模型的高层进行合并，可灵活控制大语言模型输出中词汇与语义的多样性及质量之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: A training-free depth-aware FrankenMerging approach that combines the lower layers of an aligned model with the higher layers of its base model to flexibly control the diversity-quality trade-off of LLM outputs.
